svg.title: Proposition 28: Intervention Compatibility Under Node Aggregation
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Repository theorem. Proposition 28 extends the P25 directed-influence scale theorem through the changing node set formalized by P27.. Visible guideposts include: Transporting P11 directed influence through a changing source and target node set without inventing new intervention physics.; FINE SOURCE SEMANTICS; Matched pair families Ei; Sf(e) = { i : e ∈ Ei }; A pair may carry more than one fine source label.; Those labels are part of the declared experiment design.. How to read it: follow the diagram in the direction of its arrows and use each box, panel, inequality, or highlighted region only with the meaning printed beside it. Main takeaway: this is the visual companion to Proposition 28; the proposition document supplies the assumptions, proof, and exact scope of every implication. Scientific status: Proposition 28 theorem/certificate visual. It is not independent empirical evidence and does not, by itself, identify a physical or latent variable with consciousness.
svg.text: P28 - Intervention Compatibility Under Node Aggregation
Transporting P11 directed influence through a changing source and target node set without inventing new intervention physics.
A pair may carry more than one fine source label.
Those labels are part of the declared experiment design.
One pair, at most one coarse source
Cross-fiber ambiguity blocks exact source descent.
Pooling does not imply simultaneous perturbation.
Use the full fine target fiber before state compression
The aggregate target is compared against its complete fine block, not against an arbitrary constituent coordinate.
It does not measure within-fiber intervention synergy.
A compatible target map cannot create a stronger edge.
Exact target reconstruction gives exact preservation.
aggregate source label ≠ new aggregate actuator
P28 transports declared matched comparisons. Simultaneous interventions require independently defined protocols and response laws.
P28 transports declared comparisons. Full response geometry, P11 scale equivalence, physical completeness, and experience remain open.
